tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sprul sku myur 'byon gyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa mchog snang bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal ldan stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag bde bar gshegs// rgyal dang de sras slob bcas dgongs su gsol// gang zhig re ba'i 'bras bu yongs 'grub pa'i// bla med bden pa dam pa'i skyong gyur cig /'jig rten rnam par 'dren pa'i dbang phyug gi /thugs rje'i mkha' klong chos dbyings dkyil 'khor nas// rjes su brtse ba'i nyin byed snang ba che// srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i phyir// mgon de'i sprul pa'i zlos gar mchog dam pa// rab gsal phrin las 'od stong gzi 'od can// sa gsum rgud pa'i mun tshogs mthar byed pa// 'dzam gling bstan 'gro'i pad tshal khyon yangs por// dge legs rnam par bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig pu// shar gyi sa 'dzin phrag las nye ba ru// ji ltar gzigs pa rnam pa bzhir dgongs nas// gzugs sku'i bkod pa deng 'dir 'char gyur cig /dkon mchog kun 'dus bka' brgyud rgya mtsho dang*// yi dam lha dang chos kyi srung ma'i tshogs// bden gsung bden grub rnams kyi bden pa yis// re ba'i shing rta yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa chen po rgyal ba'i dbang po dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i snang bar gyur pa'i tshe/ rjes 'jug dad pa'i blo can si tu pas mgon de'i sprul pa'i snang brnyan gsar du bzhad pa'i bden tshig smon lam du gsol ba btab pa'o// sarba madga lam/// / ༈ rgyal sras byang sems ma lus pa'i// thugs rje'i rnam rol 'dren pa'i dpal// 'od snang mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul mchog /gar dbang khyab bdag rigs kun gtso// mgon khyod gdul bya'i snang ngo ru// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing gshegs kyang*// sngon gyi thugs bskyed zab mo yis// deng 'dir ris med bstan dang 'gro// khyad par nges don snying po yi// bstan pa'i sgron me dam pa'i mgon// nyin byed 'od stong gsal 'char ba'i// ji bzhin smon pa'i bde legs stsol//

ces zhwa dmar rin po che 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas su slar yang thugs rje bskul phyir rgyal sras dpal dar mchog gi dgongs bzhed ltar/ si tus gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ rab 'byams zhing bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug che// rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i dpal mnga' ba// mgon khyod don dam skye 'jig gtan bral yang*// gdul dka' byis blo'i rtag 'dzin gzhom pa'i slad// gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor dbyings su thim gyur kyang*// deng 'dir rjes 'jug bstan dang 'gro ba la// brtse chen byams pa'i thugs kyis nyer dgongs la// mchog gi sprul sku myur bar rab gsal zhing*// 'gro kun rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa yi// bde legs dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rab rgyas shog /ji ltar smon pa yongs su smin pa'i ched// mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i bden pas myur 'grub shog / ces khyab bdag rdo rje can dngos 'dzi sgar rin po che bka' brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim skabs mchog gi sprul sku myur 'byon 'di bzhin si tus gsol ba don ldan du gyur cig / ༈ chos sku kun bzang longs sku snang mtha' yas// sprul sku mtsho skyes padma 'byung gnas te// sku gsum 'dus pa rdo rje drag po rtsal// deng 'dir brtse ba chen pos rjes dgongs shig /bdag sogs sems can mgon med gyur rnams la// chos dbyings mkha' klong ye shes dkyil 'khor nas// byams chen thugs kyi zla 'od snang ba yis// brtse ba'i bdud rtsi'i bsil rgyun dbab tu gsol// skyabs med skyob pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog /mchog gi zlos gar shar ri'i phrag pa las// dge legs bye ba'i 'od stong ldan pa gang*// dge mtshan du ma'i dpal gyis 'char gyur cig /yid srubs chu khur can gyi drwa ba rnams// dam can srung ma'i mthu rtsal rlung gis bcom// rgyal bstan padma'i 'dab stong phyogs brgyar khyab// 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan skal bzang spyod gyur cig

/ ces pa 'di'ang zur mang drung pa rin po che'i bkas bskul bzhin rdo rje drag po'i mchog sprul myur 'byon gyi gsol smon du tā'i si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos phul ba de bzhin 'grub bar gyur cig / ༈ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed las// yongs grub sgyu 'phrul karma shā sa na// gang khyod 'khor chos rtag par 'dzin zlog slad// chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang du thim gyur kyang*// deng 'dir rjes 'jug mos ldan snying rje'i mthus// yol med brtse bas dgongs la bstan 'gro yi// ngal ba pha mthar brgal phyir sprul sku ni// zla gsar thon bzhin gegs med nyid 'grub shog /dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// de ltar myur ba nyid du 'grub pa yi// bkra shis dge tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing*// rdzogs ldan dam pa'i dpal la spyod gyur cig / bla ma bstan pa zhes pa'i sprul sku myur 'byon slad dbon rigs nas bskul bzhin spel/// / ༈ rgyal dang de sras rnams kyi bden pa dang*// chos dbyings don dam bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// legs byas rgya mtsho'i gzhi las thon pa yi// deng 'dir sprul pa'i pad dkar gsar bzhad nas// mi mthun ser bu'i phyogs las rgyal gyur te// yang dag don gnas thar lam ston nus pa'i// spangs rtogs du mas mngon par phyug pa yis// bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / bla ma mi 'gyur skye srid myur 'byon du spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal rnams kyi// thugs bskyed lha lam yangs po ru// mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong kun gsal bas// gang zhig sprul pa'i pad tshal mchog /mi mthun ser bu las rgyal te// phrin las ge sar rnam par bkra// 'gro phan lhag bsam 'dab stong rgyas// rtag par dge legs 'byung gyur cig / ces bla ma chos dbyings bzang po'i skye sprul myur gsal slad bskul bzhin si tus spel/// /

༈ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i gter// rigs dang dkyil 'khor dbang phyug karma pa// yi dam lha dang chos srung mthu byin gyis// deng 'dir sprul pa'i snang brnyan chu shel dbang*// gdul bya'i rdzing bur 'gog med rtag 'char slad// shar ri'i phrag las nye bar thon nas su// mi mthun bdud sde'i mun pa pha mthar bskrad// 'gro la phan bde'i 'od dkar phyogs kun khyab// phun tshogs lnga ldan dpal la dbang 'byor zhing*// nges don bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'bras smin nas// bde legs snang bas rtag tu 'da' gyur cig / pha ri bla ma'i sprul sku myur gsal 'byon pa'i phyir dbon rigs rnams kyi ngor spel/// / ༈ bslu med mchog gsum bden pa'i mkha' dbyings las// thugs rje'i 'od stong rmad byung spel ba'i mthus// 'gro kun byang chub lam gyi padmo'i tshal// rnam par 'dzum phyir de slad skye ba yi// srid pa'i sgyu 'phrul myur bar 'char ba la// mi mthun nyes pa'i mun tshogs rgyang bsrings nas// mthun rkyen bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub pa dang*// bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces mdzes ldan nas bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum 'dus ba'i ngo bo nyid// pad 'byung thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// byin rlabs sprin phung phyogs bcur spro// rmad byung chos kyi gru char 'bebs// bstan 'gro'i ngal ba sel gyur ba'i// sprul pa'i snang brnyan pad dkar bzhin// dus kyi nyer 'tshe las rgyal te// dge legs 'dab stong rgyas gyur cig / ces dpal ldan 'brug pa'i ring lugs kyi zhabs 'degs pa zhing gshegs ngag dbang 'gyur med kyi sprul sku myur 'byon 'di bzhin bla ma don brgyud kyi bkas bskul bzhin tā yi si tus bris pa'o/// / ༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed lha lam nas// rmad byung bstan dang 'gro ba'i zhing sa ru// dge legs 'byung gnas lo tog smin pa'i phyir// deng 'dir skye ba sprul pa'i char rgyun gyi// mthu las 'jig rten rgud pa yongs bcil zhing*// phan bde'i rtsa lag nyid du myur 'grub pa'i// dkon mchog bden pas deng 'dir smon pa yi// 'dod don gegs med lhun gyis grub par shog

/ ces ras sprul myur 'byon du bla ma dam pa bstan 'dzin pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar si tus spel/// / ༈ rab 'byams rgyal kun thugs rje'i gter// 'chi med padma 'byung gnas kyi// byin rlabs mi bzad stobs chen pos// bstan 'gro phan dang bde ba'i gzhir// bla na med pa'i phrin las pa// zhing 'dir sprul pa'i snang brnyan gang*// nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing*// gegs med gsal bar 'char gyur cig /chos dbyings don dam bden pa dang*// chos can bslu med bden pa yis// re ba'i shing rta yongs gang ba'i// 'bad med lhun grub don ldan shog / ces 'ja' mo bla ma'i sprul sku myur 'byon bden tshig rgyal dbang padma thugs rje bskul ba 'di bzhin lha steng 'dus pa'i ngor spel/// / ༈ bde chen chos dbyings ngo bo nyid// sku gsum ston pa padma 'byung*// gang gi thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// bstan 'gro'i mun pa bcil ba yi// sgyu 'phrul snang byed nyin mo'i mgon// gdul bya'i pad tshal khyon yangs por// dge legs 'od stong ldan pa dang*// bka' brgyud grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur// yi dam dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// dam can chos kyi srung ma yi// byin mthus rtag par skyong gyur nas// smon pa ji bzhin lhun grub shog / bla ma pad dkar sprul sku myur 'byon du spel/// / ༈ mkha' khyab klong yangs bde chen sgyu 'phrul gar// sku gsum bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin// gang de'i byang chub thugs bskyed rmad byung ba// yal bar 'dor med slar yang bskul ba'i mthus// mchog gi snang brnyan nyin byed 'od stong can// bstan 'gro phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen// yid srubs mun pa'i dra ba gzhil slad du// dge mtshan du ma'i dpal gyis 'char gyur cig /bla med mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang*// bdag sogs rnams kyi gsol btab bden pa'i mthus// ji ltar smon pa'i 'dod don myur 'grub nas// bde legs rdzogs ldan dpal la dbang 'byor shog

/ ces lho rin po che dkon mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim skabs slar yang mchog snang myur gsal phyir lho chags med dpon slob rnams kyi bzhed ltar si tu pas gnas de nyid du spel/// / ༈ ston mchog mngon shes lnga ldan rgyal ba dang*// des gsung chos dang tshogs mchog dge 'dun te// bla med rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i mthus// ji ltar gsol ba'i smon lam yongs grub mdzod// deng 'dir bstan dang 'gro ba'i mgon dam pa// mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas brtser dgongs la// gzugs sku'i bkod pa nyin byed snang ba can// dge legs khyung sngon skyes kyis yongs bskul nas// yid srubs mun pa'i dra ba gtan du gzhil// sgrub brgyud padmo'i tshal chen phyogs mthar kun// 'gengs pa'i sems bskyed dam bca'i khur zab mos// yid kyi 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzad du gsol// zhes rje btsun chos mgon gyi mchog sprul myur 'byon du mdzod pas bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// gang 'dir byin rlabs bden tshig yongs grub pa'i// bla med rdo rje'i bden pas rnam kun tu// yid kyi shing rta re ba'i 'bras gang stsol// rgyal rnams mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin gzhan phan gyi// phrin las zab mo mkha' ltar yangs pa las// bstan 'gro'i dpal du nyin byed 'od stong can// deng 'dir gegs med gsal bar bstan du gsol// don dam rang bzhin chos dbyings stobs dag dang*// kun rdzob bslu med rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /dad dang dam tshig mos pa rnam dag mthus// ji ltar yid bzhin yongs su 'grub gyur cig / ces zur mang bla ma dam pa bstan 'dzin rin po che dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim skabs gang de'i dbon po bla ma rnams kyis bzhed ltar si tus spel ba don dang ldan gyur cig// / ༈ rgyal kun ngo bo padma 'byung gnas mchog

/gsol btab mthu las thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// byin rlabs snang byed dpal du 'bar ba yis// sgrib gnyis bag chags mun pa gtan bcom shog /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i yon tan yongs rdzogs nas// 'gro khams rgya mtsho gdul bya'i snang ba'i ngor// ye shes rgya mtsho'i rang gzugs sprul pa'i gar// smon lam rgya mtsho'i bden pas gsal gyur cig / ces si tu pas dge slong phrin las kyi bzhed ltar bla ma ye shes kyi skye srid myur gsal phyir du spel ba dge// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs rgyal ba dang*// de sras slob mar bcas kun gyi// thugs rje mkha' dbyings klong yangs nas// byin rlabs sprin tshogs gtibs pa las// yid can gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi// dad pa'i sa gzhi khyon yangs por// rnam dag dge legs 'bras smin phyir// sprul pa'i snang brnyan bdud rtsi'i char// mi mthun nyes pa'i dri bzhon gyi// g.yul las gegs med bde blag tu// yid la 'dod 'jo'i dpal sbyin te// bstan 'gro'i don chen spyod par shog / ces khra leb bla mchan nyi ma 'das pa'i skye sprul myur gsal slad bla grwa rnams kyis bskul ngor spel/// / ༈ mtha' yas rab 'byams rgyal kun thugs rje'i rgyun// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs rgya mtsho'i bdag /dpal ldan sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung*// mchog gi byin rlabs cha shas 'dab phreng las// dge legs dpyid du 'gyur ba'i zil mngar gyis// lus can gdul bya'i bung ba ji snyed pa// rdzogs ldan kun dgar spyod pa'i dpal du ni// gang de'i yang srid pad tshal bzhad gyur cig /mchog gsum ngo bo o rgyan phrin las 'od// phyogs bcu kun khyab brdal ba'i legs byas kyis// phan bde'i rang bzhin 'dab brgya grol ba dang*// 'gro kun sgrib gnyis khri mun sel gyur cig / ces pa'ang bla ma karma lhun grub kyi skye srid myur gsal gyi smon lam 'di bzhin sho pu bla grwa rnams kyi bzhed ngor si tus spel/// /

༈ rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje'i zla snang 'od// rab dkar dge ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pa'i/ bden pa dam pas deng 'dir bka' brgyud kyi// ring lugs gsal byed sprul pa'i ku mu da// nyes gsum dri yis ma bslad mthun rkyen gyi// dpal kun lhun gyis grub pa'i legs byas gang*// rab rgyas bstan 'gro'i gsos su 'gyur ba ru// bslu med dkon mchog byin mthus myur 'grub shog / ces zhing gshegs bla ma karma phun tshogs rab brtan gyi skye srid myur du 'byon bar bla grwa rnams kyi bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ bslu med skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnam gsum dang*// padma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i bden stobs kyis// bstan pa'i gsal byed bla ma gang de yi// skye ba'i srid pa myur du gsal gyur cig /rgyal bstan snying po'i ring lugs rab zhugs nas// tshad thub dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su bzung*// gsang sngags lam zhugs smin grol mthar phyin nas// bstan dang 'gro la sman pa nyid gyur cig /

ces pa'ang bla ma dam pa blo gros nyi ma'i dgongs bzhed ltar che tshang sprul sku myur gsal du spel/// / ༈ sku gsum 'dus pa'i dpyid gyur pa// rgyal dbang padmar gsol btab mthus// 'gro sgrol gdul bya'i gnyen du ni// yang srid chu skyes gsar pa'i dpal// deng 'dir dge tshogs rgya mtsho yi// mthu yis nye bar bskul nas su// myur ba nyid du rab rgyas nas// phan bde'i 'dab stong grol bar shog / ces pa'ang dgon zhabs bla ma tshe dbang rab rgyas sprul sku myur 'byon du spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i thugs klong yangs pa nas// 'gro ba'i don du rol pa'i legs byas kyi// yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan gyi// rmad byung du mas brgyan pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// deng 'dir gsal ba'i dpal dang ldan gyur cig /mchog gsum bden pa mchog dang chos nyid kyi// bden pa zab mos smon lam ji lta bar// de ltar gegs med lhun gyis 'grub par shog / ces sa ra bla ma rnam rol skye srid myur 'byon bla grwa rnams kyi ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ mchog gsum 'dus zhal padma 'byung gnas kyi// thugs rje'i bden pas deng 'dir rjes dgongs la// mchog gi bla ma'i sprul pa'i zlos gar gang*// snying po'i bstan pa mtha' rgyas spel phyir du// rgyal rnams byin rlabs ye shes klong yangs nas// myur bar byams pa'i dbyings nas brtser dgongs la// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rol gar bstan du gsol// bla med dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa dang*// chos can chos nyid bden pa zab mo dang*// bdag sogs kun rdzob rten 'brel gsol ba yis// smon pa ji bzhin yongs su 'grub gyur nas// dge 'dun sde rgyas chos spyod rab rgyas shog / ces pa'ang rtogs ldan chen po karma yan lag 'byung dang gang de'i 'dus pa rnams kyi ngor gu ru ma hā su kha'i skye srid myur 'byon du spel/// /

༈ bder gshegs rgyal ba rgyal ba'i myu gu yi// thugs rje'i gter chen rig 'dzin padma 'byung*// dbyer med rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gis byin rlabs char rgyun dngos grub stsol// gang zhig 'gro la rjes brtse'i phrin las kyi// rang gzugs mgon dpal nyid du zhal 'ches bzhin// bla med byang chen spyod pa rlabs chen po'i// ye shes gzi byin 'od snang gsal mdzod cig /deng 'dir bstan dang 'gro phan nyer 'tsho'i gzhir// skye ba sprul pa'i sku ru myur bzhad pa'i// skyabs gsum mchog rnams thugs rje bskul ba'i mthus// gegs med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// chos dbyings rang bzhin don dam bden pa dang*// chos can kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu med dang*// bdag sogs rnams kyi lhag bsam 'od dkar po'i// bden pa'i bden tshig ji bzhin yongs grub shog / ces pa 'di mgon po bla ma'i skye srid myur gsal phyir 'dus grwa rnams kyi ngor spel/// / ༈ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i rnam par 'phrul// bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs klong yangs nas// 'gro khams rgya mtshor deng 'dir snang byed kyi// dpal yon rgya mtsho rab tu gsal gyur cig /gdul bya'i mos ngor der snang gzugs kyi sku// rtag 'dzin zhen zlog zhi ba'i dbyings mnal kyang*// sngon rol snying stobs dam bca'i khur chen po// rjes dgongs 'gro rnams yal bar 'dor ram ci// de slad gsol ba'i bden 'bras bslu med mthus// skye ba sprul ba'i sku ru myur bzhengs nas// snyigs lnga'i mun chen drwa ba gzhom pa dang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po 'char gyur cig / ces pa'ang sa tham 'og min rnam grol gling gi bla ma rtogs ldan chen po dbang rgyal ba zhi bar gshegs pa'i skye sprul myur gsal phyir gang de'i zhabs rim 'dus pa rnams dang las 'dzin bcas nas bskul ngor si tu pas spel ba don dang ldan par gyur cig// /

༈ dus gsum rgyal dang dam chos 'phags tshogs kyi// thugs rje'i bden pa zab mos smon pa'i 'bras// yongs grub yid la 'dod pa 'jo ba yi// byin rlabs mchog tu deng 'dir smin gyur cig /bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel byed dge legs kyi// nyi gzhon phun sum tshogs pa'i phrin las can// bsod nams shar ri'i phrag las nye ba ru// mi mthun chu 'dzin g.yul las rnam grol nas// gang 'dir gdul bya'i pad tshal khyon yangs po// legs byas rdzogs ldan dpal gyis gang bzhin par// sprul pa'i snang brnyan gsal bar 'char gyur nas// dge 'dun sde rgyas rgyal khams bde legs shog / ces pa'ang 'jang la shri bla ma'i skye sprul myur gsal ched du 'dus tshogs nas bskul ltar spel/// / ༈ phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun ye shes rang gzugs mchog /dpal ldan sangs rgyas mtshor 'khrungs padma skyes// gang gi thugs rje mi bzad gter chen pos// deng 'dir smon lam yongs 'grub byin gyis rlobs// bstan pa dri med ring lugs gsal phyir dang*// gdul bya thar lam bkod pa'i phrin las kyi// 'gro 'dren byed por mnga' dbang bsgyur nus pa'i// sprul pa'i gzugs sku myur bar 'char gyur cig /mchog gsum bslu med don dam bden pa dang*// kun rdzob mos pa'i rten 'brel zab mo yis// ji ltar re ba'i 'bras gang yongs smin nas// bde legs dpal gyis rnam kun khyab par shog / ces pa bya btang ba'i skye sprul myur gsal slad du grwa rigs rnams nas bskul ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rje'i rnam par rol// gcig bsdus dkyil 'khor kun bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// brtse chen chos kyi dbyings nas rjes dgongs la// 'gro don bsnyel med phrin las bskyang du gsol// deng 'dir bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du// ring nas byams chen dam bca'i khur bzhes ltar// rnam 'phrul rgyun mi chad pa'i rang bzhin gyi// sprul pa'i zla snang myur bar bstan du gsol// de ltar gsol btab bden pa'i byin mthu yis// yid bzhin smon lam yongs su 'grub pa dang*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa rin chen dar rgyas shing*// rgyal khams kun tu bkra shis 'byung gyur cig

/ zhes pa dang mtshungs med bla ma bstan 'dzin pa gang gi thugs bzhed ltar/ rje gar dbang rin po che de nyid kyi sprul sku myur 'byon phyir du si tu pas 'og min karma'i gdan sar bkod ba dge// / ༈ mchog gsum ngo bo dpal ldan karma pa'i// thugs rje chen po'i ye shes 'od snang gis// deng 'dir khyab pa'i dpal yon mi bzad pas// rnam kun re ba'i shing rta 'gengs gyur cig /bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel ba'i sman mchog dang*// phan bde'i rtsa lag nyid du yongs grub pa// bla ma gang de'i skye ba'i rnam par rol// dge mtshan dang bcas ring min gsal nas su// rgyal bstan sri zhu 'dzin skyong spel nus shing*// 'gro ba'i gnyen du 'os pa'i phrin las ni// rgya chen rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab byed du// gegs med de ltar lhun gyis grub par shog / ces si tu pas dbon po bla ma karma bstan rgyas kyis bzhed ngor zur ri bla rgan gyi skye srid myur byon ched du spel ba dza ga tam/// / ༈ chos sku zag med mkha' dbyings khyon yangs por// longs sku ye shes lnga ldan nyin mor byed// sprul sku sna tshogs snang ba'i 'od 'bum brdal// dpal ldan karma ka des rnam kun skyongs// thub bstan kun dga'i dpyid gyur padmo'i tshal/ rnam par bzhad pa'i phrin las rab rgyas phyir// 'gro ba'i ngal gso'i dpal dang dpung gnyen du// skye ba'i zlos gar rab gsal ston gyur cig /chos dbyings rang bzhin don dam bden pa dang*// chos can kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu med bden// gang des deng 'dir smon pa'i dge legs tshogs// 'bad med yongs su 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / chos nyid sprul sku myur gsal ched du khra 'bo dang 'ba' lung bla ma grwa tshang rnams kyi bzhed ngor spel ba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ na mo gu ra we/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs padma 'byung*// gangs can mgon po dpal ldan karma pa// skyabs gnas rgya mtshor gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyis// 'gro sgrol thugs bskyed lha lam khyon yangs nas// mthu stobs nyin byed 'od 'bum bdal ba yis// gang 'dir bstan dang 'gro ba'i dga' tshal gnyen// ci dgar bzhad pa'i phrin las spel slad du// skye ba'i srid pa myur ba rab gsal shog

/theg gsum lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog /mi nub gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas// skye dgu snyigs lnga'i rgud pa las grol nas// rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog / khra legs mchog sprul thugs bzhed ltar gang de'i phrin las byed po'i skye sprul myur gsal bden tshig tu spel ba dge// madga lam/// / ༈ bde chen 'gyur med 'od gsal kun khyab klong*// rang byung ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs// rigs dkyil 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang*// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs lnga'i gdul bya rtag 'dzin zhen zlog phyir// chos dbyings spros bral zhi bar gzhol lags kyang*// zag med thugs kyis rjes 'jug brtser dgongs la// mchog snang nyin byed deng 'dir gsal du gsol// rgyal bstan spyi dang sgrub brgyud nges gsang snying*// 'dzin spel skyong dang 'dzam gling skye dgu yi// bsod nams zhing du gzugs sku'i rnam par rol// dge mtshan bye ba'i dpal gyis 'char gyur cig / ces skyabs rje bka' drin gsum ldan 'brug pa rin po che'i mchog snang myur 'byon du si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos rje dbon mchog gi bzhed ngor gsol ba'o/// / ༈ oṃ swasti/ srid zhi'i 'dren pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal// chos dang 'phags tshogs rgya mtshor gsol btab mthus// deng 'dir rnam 'dren mchog gnyis gdul bya'i ngor// rtag 'dzin zhen ldog chos dbyings zhi bde'i ngang*// gzhol ba kun rdzob snang tshul de ltar yang*// don dam skye dang 'gags pa'i mtshan bral bzhin// snyigs lnga'i 'gro rnams yal bar 'dor min phyir// brtse chen byams pa'i thugs bskyed rjes dgongs la// deng 'dir sprul pa'i snang byed nyi zla zung*// phrin las 'od kyi zer phreng zlos gar ni// skye dgu'i rgud pa sel dang bka' brgyud bstan// pad tshal phyogs mthar rgyas dang lhan cig par// bskal bzang rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston la// yid bzhin spyod pa'i bkra shis myur gsal shog

/ ces bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyan mchog ri bo che yang dgon rje drung rin po che dang 'phags mchog dam pa mkhan slob zhi bar mnal ba'i mchog sprul myur 'byon 'dzi sgar nas dbon mdzod pa karma bde chen gyi bzhed ngor si tu padma'i ming gis sbas yul a ta rong dang rjes 'brel thub bstan dpal spungs gandho la nas bkod pa dge// / ༈ bskal bzang rnam 'dren thub dbang ring lugs khyon// rgya mtsho'i gos can spel ba'i 'jig rten mgon// gru 'dzin bdag po phyag na padmo can// dpal ldan karma ka yi thugs rjes skyongs// gang gi phrin las 'od stong spel slad du// byin rlabs klong yangs bde chen mkha' dbyings las// sprul pa'i snang byed myur bar rab gsal ba'i// dge legs bye ba'i 'dab brgya bzhad du gsol// sgrub brgyud bstan pa rin chen phyogs mthar rgyas// skye dgu bde skyid dpal gyis gang bzhin du// bkra shis rdzogs ldan lang tsho rgyas bzhin par// phun sum tshogs pas kun tu khyab gyur cig / ces pa'ang si tu pas khra 'gu dbon po dang grwa tshang bcas kyi bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ gdod nas rang byung bde ba chen po'i gshis// mkha' khyab nam mkha'i rdo rjer byang chub cing*// lhun grub longs spyod sgyu 'phrul gar ston pas// zhing gzhan dgongs pa'i gnas la gzhol gyur kyang*// deng 'dir bstan dang 'gro la rjes brtse ba'i// thugs bskyed zab mo'i klong nas nyer dgongs la// slar yang gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor 'od dkar can// gdul bya ku mud phan bde'i dga' tshal du// mngon par gsal ba'i zer phreng snang pa ni// rmad byung dge legs bye ba'i dpal gang dag /rab rgyas rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi yon tan la// spyod pa'i mchog gsum thugs rjes skyong gyur cig / ces si tu pas rgyal sras bla ma pad dbang dang dbon mdzod bde chen bzhed ngor dpal dga'i mchog sprul gsal ba'i ched du spel ba dge// /

༈ rgyal ba kun dngos mtsho skyes padma 'byung*// sgyu 'phrul gar ston sprul pa'i rig pa 'dzin// gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen grub pa'i dbang*// tshe dbang dpal dar mchog la gsol ba 'debs// gang khyod dag pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho la// dbang bsgyur rgyal dang de sras rnam rol kyis// gdul bya rjes 'jug 'gro la brtser dgongs nas// bstan pa rin chen gsal byed sprul pa'i sku// gegs med myur du 'char ba'i dge mtshan ni// rje btsun phyag na padmo'i phrin las kyi// shing rta 'dren pa'i thugs bskyed dam bca'i khur// bsnyel med lhun gyis grub pa'i bka' drin stsol// zhes rgyal dbang rin po che'i bka' stsal spyir phebs ltar si tu pas dpal dar rin po che'i mchog sprul myur 'byon ched du phul ba madga lam/// / ༈ dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das// des gsungs lung dang rtogs pa chos kyi mchog /chags bral chos nyid bden gzigs 'phags dge 'dun// skyabs gsum thugs rje skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i// dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul mkha' nor 'od 'bum can// bstan 'gro padma'i dga' tshal dpyid kyi dpal// sgrub brgyud ring lugs spel dang 'gro ba'i mgon// sprul pa'i nyin byed gegs med myur gsal shog / ces mnyan pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku myur 'byon bden tshig dbon 'chi med sprul skus bzhed ngor spel ba dza ya/// / ༈ gdod nas dag pa sku bzhi'i rgyal srid che// yongs su rdzogs pa dpal ldan 'brug pa rje// dzñā na badzra zhes bya'i rnal 'byor mchog /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon pos skyong gyur cig /mgon de'i rjes 'jug lhag pa'i thugs stobs can// bshad sgrub gnyis kyi phrin las spel byed pa// gang gi gdul bya rdzogs nas zhi dbyings su// gzhol tshul bstan kyang slar yang zhing 'di ru// sgrub brgyud bstan pa phyogs mthar spel pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don chen sngon smon rjes dgongs la// zhi bar mi gnas theg chen sems bskyed kyi// sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ring min gsal gyur cig

/ ces lo ri sprul pa'i sku'i myur 'byon ched du chos gling nam mkha'i sgang grwa rigs rnams kyi ngor spel/// / ༈ skyabs gnas kun 'dus padmā ka ra dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro ye shes chos skyong bcas// rtsa gsum byin rlabs rmad byung bden pa'i mthus// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i phrin las shing rta gang*// 'od gsal chos dbyings mngon du byas te slar// longs spyod yongs rdzogs sgyu ma'i rol pa las// skye ba sprul sku'i snang brnyan zla ba'i gzugs// mos ldan yid mkhar myur bar gsal gyur cig /

ces si tu pas drung ram bla mchan dang las byed 'dus tshogs rnams kyi ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ chos dbyings kun khyab nam mkha'i klong yangs su// bde chen longs spyod yongs rdzogs nyin mo'i mgon// 'gro blor gang 'tshams sprul pa'i 'od stong spro// sku gsum ston pa mtsho skyes pad 'byung gi /byin rlabs nus mthu smon lam bden pa'i stobs// bslu ba med pas gang gi nges gsang bstan// phyogs brgyar spel ba'i byed po snang ba'i gnyen// gdul bya'i snang bar gegs med gsal gyur cig / ces si tu pas rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku'i myur 'byon dbon karma chos rgyal gyis bskul ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ rgyal sras gzhon nu 'jig rten mthong na dga'// rgyal bas lung bstan nā ga ardzun// rgyal mchog 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sogs// rgyal kun thugs rje'i byin 'od deng 'dir stsol// dkon mchog gdung 'tshob nges gsang theg pa che'i// bstan 'dzin bye ba'i khyu mchog sgrub brgyud kyi// phrin las chu rgyun rgya mtsho'i gos can mthar// dar rgyas mchog gi sprul sku myur gsal shog /spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i yid bzhin nor// bar chad nyer 'tshe'i phyogs las rnam grol te// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod gyur pas// nges don bstan pa'i khang bzang mdzes byed shog / lho kun bzang mchog sprul myur 'byon dge/// / ༈ de bzhin gshegs pa ma chags padma'i spyan// 'dzam gling mdzes ba'i rgyan gyur 'phags pa klu// rigs ldan padma dkar 'dzin thugs rje'i gar// 'jig rten mgon po'i snang bas byin rlabs stsol// dko~Xn mcho~Xg bstan pa'i snying po'i rnam thar gang*// 'dzi~Xn la gzhan dring mi 'jog gdod ma nas// bya~Xng chub brnyes kyang rgyas sras rol pa yis// bza~Xng po~X spyod mdzad sprul pa'i skur gsal shog /bslu med mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa yis// bstan 'gro'i bsod nams shar ri'i phrag pa nas// gang gi zla zhal myur bar rab gsal zhing*// rnam kun phan bde'i snang bas khyab gyur cig

/ lho chung yang sprul myur 'byon bcas dpal me'i mdzod dkon mchog rgyal mtshan ngor spel/// / ༈ ye shes bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin sku// dag pa'i zhing khams rgya mtshor rgyal sras tshul// ljongs 'dir gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin dbang po// grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan dpa' po mchog /chos dbyings rang bzhin mkha' khyab ting 'dzin dang*// rgyal kun ye shes gcig gyur byang chub kyang*// dmigs med thugs rje'i rol pa srid dang zhi'i// gnyis chos g.yul ngo zlog phyir sprul pa'i gar// dag pa'i mkha' la nyin mor byed pa bzhin// gsang sngags ston mchog padma sambha wa'i// phrin las phyogs brgyar snang byed dpung gnyen gang*// bstan 'gro'i mgon du myur bar gsal gyur cig / ces si tu padma'i ming can gyis dpal ldan dpa' po rin po che'i mchog sprul myur 'byon gsol 'debs dbon mdzod chos dbang bzhed ltar dge// / ༈ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i 'byung gnas mchog /bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// rnam 'phrul dpal ldan karma pa zhes grags// gang gis byin rlabs char rgyun deng 'dir stsol// ston pa'i bstan pa nges don sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs phrin las spel ba'i shing rta gang*// snyigs dus sems can gdul dka' mi bsrun pa'i// snang ngor chos dbyings zhi bar gzhol lags kyang*// sngon tshe byang chub thugs bskyed rjes dgongs la// deng 'dir sprul pa'i gar bsgyur bstan du gsol// bla med mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho yi// bden pas smon pa'i 'dod don lhun grub shog / spungs ri bla mchan bzhed don spel/// / ༈ dpal ldan sangs rgyas mtsho skyes rdo rje can// dbyer med karma pa yi thugs rje'i stobs// rmad byung byin rlabs rgyud bskul gsol btab pas// gang de'i skye ba'i srid pa bstan dang 'gror// phan bde'i rtsa lag dpyid du gegs bral bar// nongs med rab gsal gzhan phan mthar phyin shog

/ si tu pas bsod dbang sprul sku myur gsal mdzod dgon chos zur chos dar ngor spel/// / ༈ rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid// 'phags yul mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan// dzñā na siddhi'i rnam 'phrul dpal 'brug pa// grub mchog ye shes rdo rjes rgyud byin rlobs// gang 'dir dpal ldan dbyar rnga'i ring lugs kyi// rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing ris med skye dgu la// rnam bzhi'i phrin las spel ba'i bdag nyid can// gang gi sprul pa'i zla zhal bstan du gsol// mchog gsum rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs rje dang*// chos can chos nyid bden pa zab mo'i mthus// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i snang brnyan rab gsal ba// gdul bya'i mkha' la mngon par 'char gyur cig / khams pa sprul sku myur 'byon dbon dang 'dus sde'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang rtsa gsum gyi// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kun 'dus pa// khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po karma pa'i// thugs rje chen pos byang chub bar du skyongs// gang gi bstan pa'i brgyud 'dzin de nyid kyi// skye ba'i srid pa slar yang rab gsal ba// bstan 'gro'i dpyid du ring min 'char nas su// 'gro don mthar phyin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// snyigs ma'i rang mdangs mi dge'i mtshan ma rnams// zhi zhing bstan 'gror phan bde'i nyi 'od kyis// bskal bzang rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal la spyod// rnam kun bsam don chos bzhin yongs 'grub shog / 'dam dkar chos grwa'i 'dus pa rnams kyis bskul ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam lha// dpa' bo ḍā ki chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs// deng 'dir thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bum brdal bas// zhing gshegs sa lam bar chad mun tshogs bcom// sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin bla med kyi// sku bzhi'i go 'phang bde blag nyid 'grub cing// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob nas// gzhan don phrin las thogs med dbang 'byor shog

/ rdo khyim 'brug sgar grwa rigs ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rje'i spyi gzugs mchog /o rgyan chen po rang sems dbyer med par// rang byung gdod nas lhun grub ngo bor gsal// rtse gcig mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs// gang gi rnam rol sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// zhing 'di'i gdul bar bya ba'i bstan dang 'gro'i// tshogs gnyis spel phyir phun tshogs skya rengs kyis// drangs pa nyin mo'i mgon po gsal gyur cig /bla med mchog gsum rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha// rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs rmad byung bas// snyigs lnga'i rgud pa mun chen gzhom slad du// sprul pa'i snang brnyan myur bar gsal gyur cig / 'dzi sgar las phyag lhan rgyas bzhed ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ swa sti/ rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan karma pa// bka' brgyud rin chen phreng ba'i byin rlabs dang*// yi dam zhi khro dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// chos skyong dam can rgyan mtsho'i bden mthu yis// bstan 'gro phan bde'i gzhir gyur dam pa gang*// kun rdzob snang ngor zhi dbyings mnal lags kyang*// don dam ye shes rang mdangs sgyu 'phrul gar// gdul bya'i mgon du myur bar gsal gyur cig /'gal rkyen bar chad mun tshogs rgyang bsring zhing*// dri med bslab gsum snang ba'i 'od dkar kyis// lung rtogs bstan pa'i ku muta bzhad pa la// skye dgu'i snang byed gnyis par gsal gyur cig / skyid khri steng bla sprul karma don grub bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso// kun bzang padma 'byung gnas rtsa ba gsum// rab 'byams rgya mtshos ye shes klong yangs nas// rmad byung thugs rje'i char rgyun deng 'dir stsol// snyigs dus bstan dang 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// zag med chos dbyings zhi bar mnal lags kyang*// skal ldan rjes 'jug yal bar 'dor ram ci// rnam 'phrul zla zhal gsal bar bstan du gsol// sngon smon thugs bskyed zab mo'i rang bzhin dang*// bla med mchog gsum rin chen mthu byin stobs// bdag sogs mi phyed 'dun pas gsol btab kyis// re ba'i shing rta yongs su gang gyur cig

/ dpal yul mchog sprul rin po che myur bar bzhad pa'i ched du dbon sprul lhan rgyas kyi bzhed ngor bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /madga lam/// / ༈ rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs mchog /sangs rgyas pad skyes thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// byin rlabs snang ba'i nyin byed 'od brdal bas// sprul bsgyur padma'i dga' tshal gnyen gyur cig /bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la// sngon smon thugs bskyed zab mo g.yel med par// rjes su dgongs nas gzugs sku'i rnam par rol// 'gro ba'i don du myur bar bstan du gsol// mchog gsum rtsa gsum thugs rje'i mthu byin stobs// chos can chos nyid bden pa zab mo dang*// bdag sogs mi phyed mos pas 'dun pa yi// smon lam ji bzhin deng 'dir yongs 'grub shog / sa skyong nang chen sras yum gyi bzhed ngor de nyid kyi mchog sprul myur 'byon du spel ba / tshab tsha mchog sprul kyi myur 'byon rjes 'jug bla grwa rnams kyi dgongs bzhed ltar spel ba su dza ya/// / ༈ dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug karma pa'i// sgyu 'phrul thugs rje'i rol gar gang de nyid// chos dbyings zag med ngang du snyoms zhugs pa'i// thugs dgongs byang chub snying por yongs rdzogs shing*// slar yang zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// ye shes chen po'i rang gzugs rmad byung ba// gang 'dir 'gro ba'i phan bde spel phyir du// skye ba'i srid pa myur bar rab gsal shog /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang*// chos dbyings rang bzhin don dam bden pa'i mthus// ji ltar smon bzhin re ba'i 'dod don gang*// gegs med nyid du myur bar 'grub gyur cig / ces lha rtse grwa mang rnams kyi ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ bcom ldan tshe 'od dpag med rnam par 'phrul// rgyal mchog yā na sa ra ma badzre// mchog gi byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// deng 'dir 'gro ba'i dpal gyur sprul ba'i sku// mi mthun nyes gsum khri mun las grol zhing*// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas// gzhan don mtha' dag yid bzhin lhun gyis grub// tshe dpal ye shes snang ba rgyas gyur cig / ces dge rgyal gcod bla sprul sku'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang padma 'byung*// sgyu 'phrul gar ston sgrol ba'i mgon po mchog /brgyud par bcas pa'i thugs bskyed mkha' klong nas// deng 'dir bden gzung bden grub byin gyis rlobs// gang khyod skye 'jig mtshan ma ring spangs kyang*// gdul bya rtag 'dzin chos la bskul phyir du// zhi ba'i dbyings su gzims kyang slar yang ni// byang sems snang brnyan rnam rol myur ston gsol// kun btags 'khrul pa'i rjes su 'jug min kyang*// gzhan don thugs bskyed zab mos brtser dgongs la// 'gyur med yongs grub sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis// re ba'i shing rta yongs su gang gyur cig
